demos=[(di1,do1),(di2,do2),(di,do),(di4,do4)]
def stray_features(di,do):
    bl=blocks_of(di); L=lines_of(di,bl); C=crossings_of(bl)
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    rows=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if di[r][c]!=0 and (r,c) not in L:
                nb=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1) if (dr,dc)!=(0,0)]
                nb=[p for p in nb if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W]
                ortho=[(r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)]
                ortho=[p for p in ortho if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W]
                f=dict(
                  pos=(r,c),color=di[r][c],erased=do[r][c]==0,
                  n_stray_diag=sum(1 for p in nb if p not in ortho and di[p[0]][p[1]]!=0 and p not in L),
                  n_stray_ortho=sum(1 for p in ortho if di[p[0]][p[1]]!=0 and p not in L),
                  adj_cross8=any(p in C for p in nb), adj_crossO=any(p in C for p in ortho),
                  adj_crossD=any(p in C for p in nb if p not in ortho),
                  n_line_ortho=sum(1 for p in ortho if p in L),
                  n_cross8=sum(1 for p in nb if p in C),
                )
                rows.append(f)
    return rows
allf=[]
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(demos):
    for f in stray_features(a,b): f['demo']=i+1; allf.append(f)
er=[f for f in allf if f['erased']]; pr=[f for f in allf if not f['erased']]
print('erased:',[(f['demo'],f['pos'],f['color']) for f in er])
print('preserved diag-to-crossing:',[(f['demo'],f['pos'],f['color'],{k:f[k] for k in ('n_stray_diag','n_stray_ortho','adj_cross8','adj_crossO','adj_crossD','n_line_ortho','n_cross8')}) for f in pr if f['adj_cross8']])
print('erased features:',[{k:f[k] for k in ('pos','color','n_stray_diag','n_stray_ortho','adj_cross8','adj_crossO','adj_crossD','n_line_ortho','n_cross8')} for f in er])
